description: Unexplained stock loss found at a count
intended_use: Use when stock is missing and no other cause is known after a recount.
Damaged during handling, racking or picking. Attach the damage report.

description: Product past its expiry or best-before date

intended_use: Confirmed loss after investigation, for example lost pallet.

description: Quantity received differs from the ASN or PO
intended_use: Goods-in count differs from ASN. Raise the supplier claim separately.

description: Variance found by a cycle count
intended_use: Default code for a count correction once the recount is confirmed.

description: Stock moved between statuses or SKUs
intended_use: Quality or status reclassification with no quantity change overall.
Wrong SKU, wrong quantity keyed or put-away scan missed by our own receiving.
Wrong bin scanned or short pick that the system did not record.
Relabelling for clearance; no stock loss.
Only with a loss-prevention incident reference.

description: Catch-all when no other code fits
intended_use: Catch-all for adjustments that fit no other code. Should be rare and always carry a reason note; a high volume of other means the real cause is not being recorded.
